assertions.name: hecke_eigenvalues_give_det_minus_one_on_a_two_dim_block
assertions.source: the Hecke relation (s-q)(s+1/q)=0 gives spectrum {q, -1/q}; on the 2-dim irreducible V_(2,1) both eigenvalues occur, so det = q * (-1/q) = -1. Symbolic in q -- holds for every q, not just at the anchor.

assertions.name: corpus_seminormal_matrices_reproduce_det_minus_one
assertions.source: dim(V_(2,1)) = 2; 2 generator block(s); every one satisfies the Hecke relation to < 1e-40 and has det = -1 to 1.04967e-140. Taken from the corpus's own block_structure/sigma_csr, NOT hand-written.

assertions.name: det_rho_word_equals_minus_one_to_the_length
assertions.source: det is multiplicative and every letter contributes -1 (inverses too, since 1/(-1) = -1), so det rho(w) = (-1)^len(w). Hence TransferMatrixSpectrum.det_eq (M.det = 1) holds iff len(w) is EVEN: len 2 -> det 1, len 3 -> det -1, len 6 -> det 1, len 10 -> det 1, len 11 -> det -1, len 12 -> det 1

assertions.name: nuc11_interleaved_cannot_satisfy_det_eq
assertions.source: the corpus's currently-scored element nuc11_interleaved has 11 letters, which is odd, so det rho = -1 != 1 and the element cannot carry alpha through this carrier. This is INDEPENDENT of qou-99qc's route to the same element: that one goes through the 1-dim alternating block's character and SDP-admissibility, this one through the 2-dim block's determinant and the carrier's det_eq.

description: CORRECTED SAME DAY -- largely a RE-DERIVATION. Bean qou-pdix already carries the parity law twice (lines ~81 and ~1409) and states it MORE STRONGLY: 'the carrier's M.det = 1 field is automatic and free on the braid image -- it was never the obstruction'. qbeta_mbeta_v21_spectrum_under_d.py independently records det T_pp = det T_nn = -1 and labels its det=1 assertion 'even word length'. Corpus-grep path 6 (grep the beans) was not run before writing this, on the probe's own bean. What survives as this probe's own: the application to nuc11_interleaved (11 letters, odd -- the bean never names it), whose force is limited because branch 1 is independently excluded; and the Hecke-relation gate, which caught a hand-written sigma_2 that produced a nonsense determinant. Original description follows. The eigenphase carrier QOU.QBeta.EigenphaseCarrier.TransferMatrixSpectrum has two fields; its SECOND (det_eq : M.det = 1) is a parity constraint. Every Hecke generator has spectrum {q, -1/q} by the Hecke relation, so on the 2-dim irreducible V_(2,1) det rho(sigma) = -1 per letter and det rho(w) = (-1)^len(w). Hence only EVEN-length words can carry alpha through this carrier. Corroborates, and does not duplicate, QOU.Mass.AltCharShiftMultiset.wordChar_sign -- that is the 1-dim ALTERNATING block's CHARACTER, this is the 2-dim block's DETERMINANT, and they reach the same parity from different places. Consequence: nuc11_interleaved (11 letters, odd) cannot satisfy det_eq. No alpha is derived and no word is searched.

scope: (a) scope-limited, and mostly NOT NEW (see duplicates). A NECESSARY but AUTOMATIC condition on the carrying word, not a derivation of alpha and not a sufficient condition for anything. It does not exclude alpha, does not select a word, and says nothing about trace_eq -- the field that actually carries alpha. An even-length word satisfying det_eq may still fail trace_eq.
